segments.text:
PErceyue ye not, howe that they whiche runne in a courſe, runne all, but one receyueth the rewarde? So runne that ye may obtayne: Euerye man that proueth maſteryes, abſtayneth from all thynges. And they doe it to obtayn a crowne that ſhall periſhe, but we to obtaine an euerlaſting crowne. I therefore ſo runne, not as at an vncertayne thyng. So
fight I, not as one that beateth the ayre: but I tame my body, and bryng it into ſubieccion, leſte by any meanes it come to paſſe, that when I haue preached to other, I my ſelfe ſhould be a caſtawaye.
